items: 【Elegant and Stylish Design】LOVEVOOK laptop bag features a unique original design with an elegant and stylish exterior, perfectly showcasing the taste of modern urban elites.The cleverly designed front pocket enhances the practicality tote bag. Not only does it add a sense of depth to the overall appearance, but it also provides convenience for storing essential items such as phones, wallets, and business cards, keeping everything organized.

【Perfect Size Work Bag】The dimension of the work bag for women is 16.5" x 5.9" x 12.5"(L*W*H). Handle drop: 6.3''. Small Clutch:8" x 5" Net weight: 2.31 lbs. Adjustable shoulder strap is 27~48 inches. Suitable for most 13"/14"/15"/15.6" laptops, and it is large enough to make your daily stuff well organized.

【Large Tote Bag】Where Fashion Meets Responsibility. Crafted with PU leather and wear-resistant lining, it blends innovative design with effortless portability. Elegant exterior, spacious interior—embracing a lifestyle of quality.

【Spacious Design】The dedicated laptop compartment ensures comprehensive protection. Internal Water Bottle holder bag and pen slots keep items organized. The back features a zippered pocket for conveniently storing personal belongings.

【Versatile Tote Bag】Work bags for women comes with comfortable handle and detachable & adjustable shoulder strap, perfect for both business and casual occasions. Ideal laptop tote bag for daily use at work, shopping, dating, college and other occasions as a handbag, laptop bag, teacher tote bag, computer bag, college shoulder bag, ladies briefcase, crossbody work bag.Choose LOVEVOOK and let every step be a statement of style.
